name: Bright Data

env_keys.comment: Comparison only; anysearch does not read a key for this provider.

mode.comment: Fast SERP has separate access requirements; no anysearch fast/balanced/deep mapping.

notes: Comparison only; no anysearch SDK adapter is claimed.

requires_key.comment: REST request API requires bearer API key; proxy interface uses zone credentials.

snippet.comment: Parsed organic results expose description (search snippet).

domains.comment: Indirect engine query operator: provider forwards q in a Google search URL, and Google documents site:. This documented composition is not a typed domain allow/deny guarantee.

country.comment: gl selects two-letter search country; localization is documented.

language.comment: hl sets page/interface language; engine-supported language semantics, not a guarantee every result has that language.

date.comment: tbs filters publication time by engine-supported ranges; engine-specific date syntax rather than typed start/end fields.

safe_search.comment: safe=active or safe=off enables/disables Google SafeSearch.

answer.comment: Parsed Google ai_overview is available when the upstream SERP includes it; no guaranteed independent synthesized answer.

content.comment: Parsed JSON/HTML/Markdown formats describe the SERP response, not fetched full text of linked result pages. Separate scraper products are outside this column.

summary.comment: The documented organic response has description snippets, not generated per-result page summaries. Upstream AI Overview is a separate SERP element.

highlights.comment: snippet_highlighted_words exposes engine-highlighted terms, not a standalone excerpt generation service.

news.comment: tbm=nws selects Google News results; dedicated Fast SERP News also documented.

native_api.value: SERP proxy; requests are not individual organic links; async collection not another billed request.

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.

pricing_per_1k.value: PAYG $1.50 / 1K successful requests; Scale $499/month includes 380K then $1.30 / 1K
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.
